title: CloudDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain
abstract: Reconstructing dense 3D scenes from sparse LiDAR point clouds (LiDAR scene completion) is a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving, where diffusion models offer a promising solution. However, existing approaches rely on object-level autoencoders that collapse into unstable global representations at outdoor scale, and suffer from ground truth data corrupted by odometry drift that systematically degrades supervision quality. Furthermore, multi-step diffusion inference incurs prohibitive latency for real-time deployment. We present CloudDiffusion, addressing these issues with three independent components. First, a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling provides stable scene-scale LiDAR compression as a standalone reconstruction module, avoiding the global-pooling and codebook-collapse failure modes of prior point-cloud autoencoders. Second, an anchor-based ICP ground truth refinement pipeline eliminates drift-induced noise from training supervision, reducing our single-step x0 diffusion teacher's squared Chamfer distance by approximately 16x on SemanticKITTI seq. 08 (0.396 to 0.024 m^2) with no model change (partly aided by the denser, more compact refined references). Third, the same teacher completes scenes in a single x0 step, operating directly in coordinate space, not in the VAE latent. It runs in near real time at 209ms/frame, 65-138x lower inference latency than iterative diffusion baselines. Our results indicate that data quality dominates model design in this regime, and suggest that multi-token latent spaces could serve as a stable first stage for future latent diffusion-based scene completion.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2606.16048v3 全文整理；Code URL 使用作者在 PDF 中印出的公开仓库。
analysis.ideaZh: 在 point-cloud coordinates 中做 single-step scene completion，并把 compact Gaussian-token VAE、anchor-based ground-truth refinement 与 frozen-backbone coordinate denoiser作为三个独立组件研究。
methodFlow: 对齐 sparse LiDAR observation 与 completion reference，并构造 coordinate scaffold
用 Gaussian-token VAE 做独立的 scene-scale point-cloud representation
冻结 Point Transformer backbone，只训练轻量 coordinate denoiser
以 single-step x0 prediction 替代迭代 diffusion sampling
分别在 refined 与 standard references 下比较 accuracy 和 runtime
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它属于 broad 3D Generation/Completion，对 point-cloud coordinate models、single-step generation 与 supervision quality 有参考价值；尤其值得保留的是它通过 cross-evaluation 拆分 ground-truth refinement 与真正 model gain。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 matched refined-reference squared Chamfer 从 0.396 降至 0.024，但在固定 reference 的 cross-evaluation 中净模型改进只有 8.1%（p. 5）。CloudDiffusion 推理为 209 ms，同硬件 LiDiff 为 20.56 s、ScoreLiDAR 为 4.72 s，而非 diffusion 的 LiNeXt 为 167 ms；在 standard reference 下 linear Chamfer 为 0.496，弱于 LiDiff 0.434、ScoreLiDAR 0.406 与 LiNeXt 0.149（p. 5）。
analysis.caveatZh: refined target 同时改变密度与对齐程度，不能把 matched-table 的约 16× 差异都归因于模型。VAE 只在 50 个 validation frames 上报告且尚未接入 diffusion pipeline；target-derived scaffold 的信息边界也需要更严格验证。作者明确说明完整 DDPM 训练不稳定，single-step formulation 限制 stochastic diversity。
analysis.motivationZh: Outdoor LiDAR completion 同时面临 scene-scale point-cloud representation 不稳定、odometry drift 污染监督，以及多步 diffusion 推理过慢的问题，因此需要分别检查表示、数据与采样三类瓶颈。
analysis.methodZh: Gaussian-token VAE 用 cross-attention pooling 将点云编码为 grid-like multi-token latents；anchor ICP pipeline 重新对齐并加密 completion targets。实际 completion model 不在 VAE latent 中工作，而是冻结 Point Transformer backbone、训练 8.9M-parameter denoiser直接预测 clean coordinates，并用 target-derived scaffold 形成输出坐标结构。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 SemanticKITTI 上测试 VAE、reference refinement 与 completion，比较 LiDiff、ScoreLiDAR 和 LiNeXt，并尽量在 RTX 4090 上重新计时。作者报告 VAE squared Chamfer 为 0.120±0.026、推理 1.6 ms；但标准 reference 下 accuracy 不领先，且三部分尚未形成统一端到端系统。
analysis.insightZh: 这篇工作的首要结论不是 diffusion architecture 的突破，而是评价 target 的定义可能主导表面增益；对 completion 系统，模型、scaffold 与 ground-truth refinement 必须在同一 reference 下交叉核算。
